notes.title: Silverwood Bay: An Eleanor Grey Mystery is Available Now!
notes.content:
Mystery writer Eleanor Grey has just moved from the big city to Silverwood Bay in search of inspiration for her next novel, but it doesn’t take long for the inspiration to find her! Embark on a thrilling hidden object adventure with "Silverwood Bay: An Eleanor Grey Mystery"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881759/b44eec06e01f3a74c85da5014f74e70cc7a54e8f.gif[/img]

Explore captivating scenes filled with hidden clues and uncover the truth behind the old brooch and romantic note found in a mysterious package from her friend Josie.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881759/987aa8bf4eea1556b1660b68c39f79d06a7af324.gif[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Follow the story of Eleanor Grey
[*] Solve a Romance Mystery
[*] Go on an Adventure in Silverwood Bay
[*] 28 chapters with 1-2 sub scenes
[*] 28 subgames relating to the story
[/list]
[h2]Collector's Edition[/h2]
[list]
[*] 7 Epilogue chapters
[*] 7 Epilogue chapter wallpapers
[*] Music player
[/list]

Join Eleanor as she unravels the secrets of Silverwood Bay and brings her long-awaited story to life in this immersive hidden object game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710080/Silverwood_Bay_An_Eleanor_Grey_Mystery/

notes.title: I Love Finding Critters - Cinco de Mayo Update
notes.content:
In this Cinco de Mayo update, enjoy 2 new beautiful hidden object scenes. Search for a variety of critters and objects while traveling through scenes inspired by [b]Hidalgo [/b]and [b]Jalisco, Mexico[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41938734/f34b6f0719fc3407e87fd7734824fe8072a58d3c.jpg[/img]

If you like playing I Love Finding Critters and other hidden object games, you may also like our upcoming game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823330/Faircrofts_Antiques_The_Mountaineers_Legacy/]Faircroft's Antiques: The Mountaineer’s Legacy[/url]. Add it to your wishlist now!

notes.title: Next Fest Demo - Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]First Time in Paris[/b] is joining Steam Next Fest! 
Download the demo and let us know what you think here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1767150/discussions/2/. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41462639/9ba8d39147fa33a1aadf86ded806b2013c3af33a.jpg[/img]

A new Hidden Object adventure begins! Kate Robinson is an amateur travel blogger who's taking on her first big job—and it's in Paris! Join her and her daughter Nicole as they save the Hotel Hospitalité, all while making new friends and new memories in the City of Love!

[list]
[*] Explore lavishly illustrated and animated locations!
[*] Help Kate save the Hotel Hospitalité!
[*] Discover the magic of Paris through over 30 different mini games!
[*] Revisit gorgeous locations in Unlimited Mode!
[*] Unlock achievements by playing through the game!
[*] Includes downloadable wallpapers and the full soundtrack!
[/list]
